shots.visual: Over-the-shoulder shot looking at a tactical sand table inside a dimly lit tent. A hand points firmly at a desolate valley on the map while a strategist shakes his head in utter disbelief.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 此處荒涼，魏軍絕不可能經過！

shots.visual: Close-up of a stern ruler looking down with cold confidence, backlit by dramatic warm candlelight in the military tent.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 三日後，曹真必死於此！

shots.visual: Medium shot of a strategist holding a feather fan, staring with wide eyes in complete shock and doubt.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公何出此言？這簡直是賭博！

shots.visual: Close-up of an intense ruler turning around with an unshakeable, terrifyingly commanding gaze.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 軍師不必多言，照朕的吩咐去辦！

shots.visual: Medium shot of a worried advisor bowing slightly, trembling with deep anxiety under heavy atmospheric lighting.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 若魏軍不來，我軍必陷絕境啊！

shots.visual: Close-up of a cold smirk under dim lantern light, eyes sharp with prophetic certainty.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 曹丕狂妄，曹真必急於搶功！

shots.visual: Medium shot of a strategist sighing softly, reluctantly lowering his feather fan in resignation.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 亮……遵命便是。

shots.visual: Medium shot of a commander flicking his robe and stepping out into the shadows with supreme dominance.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 傳令三軍，即刻出發埋伏！

shots.visual: Wide cinematic shot of a misty, desolate mountain canyon under dark gray skies, eerie and quiet.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 三日後，無名山谷寒風凜冽。

shots.visual: Medium shot of a strategist standing on a cliff edge, looking down nervously into the empty foggy canyon.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 時辰快到了，依舊毫無動靜。

shots.visual: Close-up of an anxious face sweating slightly under the biting cold wind, forehead tightly furrowed.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 難道主公這次真的算錯了？

shots.visual: Medium shot of a calm ruler standing beside his advisor, gazing forward with absolute composure.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 不急，獵物已經進網了。

shots.visual: Wide shot of sudden war fires and smoke erupting simultaneously across the valley floor beneath heavy dust.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 突然間，山谷內殺聲震天！

shots.visual: Medium shot of enemy cavalry banners blundering straight into the narrow canyon ambush trap.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 魏軍大旗竟然真的出現了！

shots.visual: Extreme close-up of a strategist's dilated eyes reflecting flames and chaos, overwhelmed by utter shock.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 什麼……敵軍真的中計了？！

shots.visual: Close-up of a ruthless ruler overlooking the carnage, a cold triumphant smile gracing his face.

lines.speaker: liu_bei
lines.text: 曹真，你的死期到了。

shots.visual: Wide panoramic shot of thousands of flaming arrows raining down onto the trapped army inside the rocky gorge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 伏兵齊出，魏軍死傷無數！

shots.visual: Medium shot of a strategist standing frozen on the cliff, lips trembling in disbelief.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 未卜先知……這怎麼可能？！

shots.visual: Close-up shot of a hand trembling violently until its fingers involuntarily loosen their grip.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 羽扇從無力鬆開的手中滑落。

shots.visual: Close-up in slow motion of a pristine white feather fan striking the muddy ground, fluttering softly.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 這一敗，徹底顛覆了軍師認知。

shots.visual: Over-the-shoulder shot looking past a tall, imposing emperor toward a trembling advisor who stares at his back in awe and dread.

lines.speaker: zhuge_liang
lines.text: 主公……您究竟是如何預知的？
